newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia March palm oil exports 608,638t-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia March palm oil exports 608,638t-SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for March were 608,638 tonnes against 453,287 tonnes in February.
It said the exports comprised 165,347 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 239,893 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 50,195 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products were 153,203 tonnes.
China was the top buyer in March, taking 109,950 tonnes, followed by Pakistan which bought 68,920 tonnes, India (40,831 tonnes) and Japan (37,090 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 95,912 tonnes.
